graph.proposal: You need a RAG chatbot for your non‑profit docs. I also designed and delivered a multi‑step support agent with human approval using async job workers in Python and LangGraph for a non‑profit organization. I will set up a shared dashboard for the team and provide weekly progress updates as outlined in the deliverables. Could we schedule a brief call this week to discuss your document sources and preferred deployment environment?

You are looking to improve your Pinecone pipeline for your e‑commerce company. I have shipped a Pinecone solution for an e‑commerce client, matching your requirements. I also have experience deploying Docker containers for SaaS applications, which can be adapted to your Docker needs. While I have not yet documented async Python backend work, I will design an asynchronous architecture using best‑practice libraries such as FastAPI and asyncio. I will provide weekly progress updates and set up a shared dashboard so the team stays informed. I can start this week and will share a short implementation plan on a call. Would you like to schedule a brief call to discuss the current pipeline and outline the next steps?

You need an Airflow expert for a marketing agency prototype. My experience includes designing LLM orchestration frameworks, illustrated by a non‑profit chatbot evaluation harness and a SaaS LLM evaluation proposal. I have implemented MLflow tracking in SaaS and healthcare projects, with a documented precision of 61% and recall of 54% on a healthcare visual defect detection task. I will deliver a comprehensive test suite and a shared dashboard to meet your deliverables. When would you like to schedule a brief call to discuss the prototype architecture and timeline?

You need an ML engineer to develop and train a PyTorch model for your marketing agency. I have delivered fine‑tuned open models for ticket classification, training deep learning models with Hugging Face and PyTorch for an edtech client in 2022. I designed LLM evaluation harnesses using LLM chains and tools for legal and non‑profit chatbots, automating previously manual processes. My proposals for SaaS and logistics projects show I have shipped production Hugging Face pipelines integrated with Airflow and PyTorch. In a prior LLM evaluation project I caught four regressions before release in the first month. Would you like me to outline a two‑week sprint plan for the PyTorch model and the weekly test suite?

You need an LLM agent with LangChain and RAG to provide retrieval‑augmented answers over PDFs. I also created a document Q&A assistant for an e‑commerce team using RAG and LangChain, demonstrating end‑to‑end PDF handling. I would test the agent by writing unit tests for each LangChain component, mocking LLM calls, and running integration tests that verify PDF retrieval returns correct answers on a held‑out validation set. Would you like me to share a brief project outline and schedule for a kickoff call?

You need to improve your LLM evaluation pipeline. I have designed and delivered LLM evaluation harnesses that automated slow manual processes for a legal chatbot, using Python and async job orchestration. I would write unit tests for each evaluation component, then create integration tests that run the full pipeline inside Docker, and include them in an automated CI pipeline. I will provide a concise handover document that outlines the architecture, Docker setup, and how to extend the evaluation suite. The deliverables will include the Dockerized pipeline, the full test suite, and the documentation ready for your team. When would you like to schedule a brief call to discuss the current pipeline and outline the first milestones?

You need an LLM agent built with Python and scikit-learn for your logistics operations. In 2026 I migrated an edtech app to AWS, cutting hosting costs by 31%, demonstrating my skill in optimizing backend infrastructure. For the managed vector database component I would evaluate options such as Pinecone or Milvus and integrate them via their Python SDKs, ensuring scalability. I will provide weekly progress updates and a comprehensive test suite using pytest to validate the LLM agent’s functionality. Would you like me to outline the initial architecture for the LLM agent?

You need to build an MVP with Tailwind and React. My React work includes component‑based UIs, such as a customer dashboard that reduced page load from 6 seconds to 2 seconds. For caching, I would integrate an in‑memory solution like Redis to meet your performance needs. I can start this week and will provide a short implementation plan on a call. The deliverables will include a comprehensive test suite for the API and the UI, ensuring reliable functionality. Would you like to schedule a brief call to discuss the MVP scope and timeline?

You need to fix and extend your FastAPI dashboard. I have delivered FastAPI solutions for an edtech client, integrating PostgreSQL and handling complex data flows. In a manufacturing platform backend I eliminated double‑bookings across 7,000 records, demonstrating my ability to improve reliability in FastAPI services. I have shipped React front‑ends for legal and e‑commerce projects, delivering production‑ready interfaces that work with WebSockets and Celery. I have built Playwright test suites for logistics and legal applications, increasing release frequency from 2 to 5 per month in one SaaS project. I can start this week and will share a short implementation plan on a call. Would you like me to outline the test coverage strategy for the dashboard before we begin?

You need a forecasting expert for monthly KPIs for your non-profit. I have delivered forecasting solutions, such as a demand forecast for a marketing agency distributor that cut stock‑outs by 61%. I measured the uplift of changes in a checkout experiment for a non‑profit store, identifying a 42% conversion increase with 95% confidence. My Looker Studio experience includes a travel client where I produced a conversion uplift analysis of 55% at 95% confidence. I will deliver a shared Power BI or Looker Studio dashboard together with a concise hand‑over document, and I will set up a reproducible container environment using standard Docker practices. Would you like to schedule a brief call so I can outline the dashboard structure and container workflow?

You need a dbt expert for monthly KPIs. I also automated reporting in Google Sheets and Excel for legal and edtech agencies, demonstrating seamless integration with Snowflake data. I can provide a comprehensive test suite for the dbt project and will send weekly progress updates as required. I can start this week and will share a short implementation plan on a call. Would you like to schedule a brief call to discuss the test suite design and timeline?

I can also build the executive dashboard layer you require, as demonstrated in a Power BI KPI workbook that reduced reporting time by 22% for a fintech group. I can start this week and will share a short implementation plan on a call. Would you like to schedule a brief call to discuss the specific metrics and timeline?

You need a data analyst who can work with Pandas and integrate results into a WordPress site while also forecasting next quarter’s numbers and tuning warehouse costs. I also built a Pandas‑driven logistics dashboard that replaced seven weekly manual reports. My forecasting work for a non‑profit client accurately predicted quarterly KPIs and reduced reporting time by 49%. I can begin this week and will provide a short implementation plan on our first call. I will set up a test suite to validate each Pandas pipeline, forecast model, and warehouse cost calculation, and will send weekly progress updates. Would you like me to share a brief outline of the test plan before we start?

You need a data analyst to handle statistics and Solidity for your legal company. I have delivered cloud data warehouse solutions using dbt and Snowflake for both healthcare and e‑commerce teams, automating manual processes. For significance testing I would design appropriate statistical experiments and integrate them into your repo with a full test suite. Would you like me to share a brief implementation plan and schedule a quick call to discuss details?

On “Executive KPI workbook for a fintech group” I cut monthly reporting time by 22%. On “Sales performance dashboard for a marketing agency company” I replaced 6 weekly manual reports. On “Executive KPI workbook for a travel group” I cut monthly reporting time by 49%, which covered Tableau. Could you share what a successful first week looks like for you? I can send a one-page plan.

You need a data analyst experienced with BigQuery, forecasting with confidence intervals, and measuring uplift for A/B tests. I also implemented BigQuery for an edtech client, ensuring scalable analytics and Tableau reporting. For forecasting, I designed and deployed a demand forecast model with confidence intervals for a travel distributor, using Python to automate the process. Similarly, I created a confidence‑interval forecast for a fintech distributor, streamlining their previously manual workflow. I measured the uplift of a change in a non‑profit store experiment, identifying a 42% conversion increase at 95% confidence. Would you like to schedule a brief call to discuss the project scope and next steps?
